hero.alt: The Paws 2 Purrs daycare pack, huskies, a doodle and small dogs, on a woodland track in Arnold, Nottingham, next to Vanessa's hand-painted Paws2Purrs sign
hero.caption: Pack photo by the sign. Everyone (nearly) looked.

vanessaHusky.alt: Vanessa, owner of Paws 2 Purrs, smiling in the woods cheek to cheek with a husky
vanessaHusky.caption: Me and one of my favourite huskies.

vanessaSelfie.alt: Vanessa taking a selfie on a woodland walk with huskies from the pack behind her
vanessaSelfie.caption: Selfie with the pack, mid-walk.

daycareGroup.alt: A mixed group of daycare dogs, including huskies, a terrier and a black Labrador cross, among fallen trees in autumn woodland
daycareGroup.caption: Autumn woods, full pack, muddy paws guaranteed.

lakeDoodle.alt: A husky and a cream doodle standing together on a sandy lakeside under a bright blue sky
lakeDoodle.caption: Beach day, Nottingham style.

lakePaddle.alt: A husky on a long line paddling out into a calm lake
lakePaddle.caption: Long line on, straight in for a paddle.

lakeEdge.alt: A grey and white husky stepping out of the water at the edge of a lake
lakeEdge.caption: Back out of the water and looking very pleased.

howl.alt: A husky lying in sunny grass by a fallen log, head back mid-howl
howl.caption: Huskies don't bark. They sing.

spaniels.alt: A Cavalier-type spaniel and a small long-haired dog on leads on a shady woodland path
spaniels.caption: Small legs, big adventures.

boarding.alt: A black and tan cocker spaniel settled in a soft dog bed in a cosy living room, home boarding rather than kennels
boarding.caption: Home boarding means a proper bed and a warm room.

smallFluffy.alt: A small fluffy ginger dog looking up happily from long grass in a field
smallFluffy.caption: Small dogs welcome. This face says it all.

smallLog.alt: A small tan and black dog standing proudly on a mossy log among autumn leaves
smallLog.caption: King of the log.

brindlePath.alt: A brindle dog trotting along a narrow woodland path towards the camera
brindlePath.caption: Heading back to see what's taking us so long.

brindleSmile.alt: A brindle dog with eyes closed and a huge happy grin, resting by a log
brindleSmile.caption: Pure contentment after a long walk.

taxi.alt: A husky in the back of the car holding a yellow and blue ball, ready to be picked up for a walk
taxi.caption: Pet taxi. Ball compulsory.

cookies.alt: A husky eyeing a plate of homemade roasted pumpkin and sweet potato dog cookies
cookies.caption: Homemade pumpkin and sweet potato cookies. Supervised by a husky.
